NOTIFY-004.summary: Every notification, digest, invitation and reminder is sent from the configured no-reply address, or from RER's assigned verified sender on Managed hosting, and marked auto-generated; Pencil still ingests no inbound mail.
NOTIFY-004.was: Every notification, digest, invitation and reminder is sent from the configured no-reply address and marked auto-generated, so response notifications and digests require a plain noreply@ or no-reply@ sender.
NOTIFY-004.now: The same, except that on Managed hosting RER's assigned verified relay sender is the sending address for notifications and digests too; the relay marks every message auto-generated. SendGrid and Resend installations keep the plain noreply@ or no-reply@ requirement.

proseChanges.summary: Describe Managed mail through the RER relay and pin rer 0.2.24.
proseChanges.was: Deployment needed a Cloudflare account and production inputs, with no Managed mail path; install used rer 0.2.21.
proseChanges.now: Managed hosting sends mail through the RER relay with no provider account or API key; Free and Assisted keep SendGrid or Resend, and direct Cloudflare deployment needs your own provider, verified sender and key. Install uses rer 0.2.24.

migrations.buyerSteps: Add the refreshed Base import kit's preparation checkpoints, stream sources and erasure progress records. Additive: existing import custody, responses and applied migrations are unchanged, and the new records are kept in backups. Local installs: run rer setup after pulling, or rer dev applies it before serving. Hosted deployments apply it through rer deploy.

publicReleaseNotes: Pencil 0.5.1 changes only the catalogue description, which is now: Collect feedback, understand responses, and turn insights into assigned actions. Description only; no product change. The application, contract, migrations and configuration are identical to 0.5.0.
agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.0: description only; no product change. Update the checkout to v0.5.1; no migration, configuration, data or redeploy step is needed. From an earlier version, first follow the upgrade to 0.5.0 (RELEASE.json at tag v0.5.0).
